```mjs title=main.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";

// ./asset.txt
const asset_namespaceObject = __webpack_require__.p + "fc4025c177fc1fe9.txt";
// ./index.js
const asset = new URL(/* asset import */asset_namespaceObject, __webpack_require__.b);

it("should use the asset module value without a module dispatcher", () => {
	expect(asset.href).toMatch(/\.txt$/);
});

export {};

```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs
// The require scope
var __webpack_require__ = {};

// webpack/runtime/public_path
(() => {
__webpack_require__.p = "";
})();
// webpack/runtime/module_chunk_loading
(() => {
__webpack_require__.b = new URL("./", import.meta.url);;

      // object to store loaded and loading chunks
      // undefined = chunk not loaded, null = chunk preloaded/prefetched
      // [resolve, Promise] = chunk loading, 0 = chunk loaded
      var moduleInstalledChunks = {"runtime": 0,};
      // no install chunk// no chunk on demand loading
// no external install chunk
// no on chunks loaded
// no HMR
// no HMR manifest

})();

export { __webpack_require__ };

```
